ncec21a08b9.headline: Lloyds sets aside £1.2bn for car finance saga as profits slide by a fifth
ncec21a08b9.summary: Lloyds added a £700 million provision in the final three months, bringing its car finance provisions to £1.2 billion including £450 million set aside last year. Profits slid by a fifth.
ncec21a08b9.why: Lloyds Banking Group is one of the UK's largest retail banks, so provisions for motor finance redress affect its earnings and capital.

n1f756e9912.headline: Money News with Deb Knight - 20th February
n1f756e9912.summary: Whyalla steelworks is receiving a $2.4 billion government bailout. Wesfarmers profits rose on gains at Kmart and Bunnings, and unemployment is at 4.1%.
n1f756e9912.why: Government support for major industrial employers affects regional economies, steel supply and public finances.

na25d499950.headline: Blue Label reveals plan to repay R175m Cell C debt
na25d499950.summary: JSE-listed Blue Label Telecoms committed to settle Cell C's R175 million debt by December 2026.
na25d499950.why: Blue Label is a South African telecoms and prepaid airtime distributor, so debt commitments affect its balance sheet and exposure to Cell C.

n6415d85ef9.headline: Wema Bank now industry's best-paying lender after new salary bump
n6415d85ef9.summary: Senior banking officers at Wema Bank, who previously earned ₦1.07 million, will now take home more than ₦1.2 million monthly. This is above Access Bank's ₦1.1 million.
n6415d85ef9.why: Wema Bank is a Nigerian commercial bank, and pay levels affect its cost base and staff retention against rivals.

na298107818.headline: Trump trade conflict casts shadow over access to vital elements needed by technology sector
na298107818.summary: Lithium and other elements needed for US defence, energy and other applications could become harder to obtain if protectionist tariffs aimed at China proceed. The report flags supply risk for the technology sector.
na298107818.why: Critical minerals such as lithium are key inputs for batteries and electronics, and trade restrictions on them can raise costs and disrupt supply chains.

nbb5ef3cda1.headline: How Trump's tariffs on steel and aluminum could hit you at the grocery store
nbb5ef3cda1.summary: US tariffs could raise the price of steel and aluminium cans, and the increase may be passed on to consumers at the grocery store. The effect would depend on how costs are passed through.
nbb5ef3cda1.why: Steel and aluminium tariffs raise input costs for packaging and manufacturing, which can feed into consumer prices and inflation.

n05238247b2.headline: Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Approves Saudi Riyal Symbol
n05238247b2.summary: King Salman approved the Saudi riyal symbol on Thursday, a move described as historic. SAMA Governor Ayman Al-Sayari thanked the Crown Prince for launching it.
n05238247b2.why: The Saudi riyal is the currency pegged to the US dollar, and the Saudi Arabian Monetary Authority (SAMA) manages it as the central bank.

n2fbf4246cf.headline: Exclusive-Indian refiners cancel palm oil orders due to price surge
n2fbf4246cf.summary: Indian refiners have cancelled orders for 70,000 metric tons of crude palm oil due for delivery from March to June. They cited a surge in benchmark Malaysian palm oil prices.
n2fbf4246cf.why: India is one of the world's largest edible oil importers, and palm oil prices from Malaysia are the global benchmark for the commodity.

nb8e851c259.headline: Money supply peaks at N110.98trn in January
nb8e851c259.summary: Nigeria's broad money supply surged to an all-time high of N110.98 trillion in January 2025, according to Central Bank of Nigeria data.
nb8e851c259.why: Broad money growth is a key monetary indicator, and rapid expansion can feed inflation and pressure the naira.

n68192bf0fb.headline: Bank of Cyprus Holdings PLC (BKCYF) Q4 2024 Earnings Call Highlights: Record Profits Amid ...
n68192bf0fb.summary: Bank of Cyprus Holdings reported a record net profit and a strategic listing shift. It faces declining net interest income and rising costs, according to its Q4 2024 earnings call.
n68192bf0fb.why: Bank of Cyprus is the island's largest lender, and its margins and listing decisions matter to investors in Cypriot banking.

nd8f39df069.headline: Public service jobs face axe in fresh bid to fix budget
nd8f39df069.summary: Up to 3,000 public service jobs are set to be cut as an Australian state seeks to repair its budget, according to the report.
nd8f39df069.why: Public-sector job cuts and spending reductions are a standard budget-repair tool that affects state finances and government bond issuance.

n84cdf158c6.headline: iPhone SE, iPhone 14 Discontinued In India After iPhone 16e Launch
n84cdf158c6.summary: Apple has discontinued the third-generation iPhone SE, iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Plus in India after the launch of the iPhone 16e, with remaining stock available through third-party retailers.
n84cdf158c6.why: Apple is one of the world's largest smartphone makers, and its product line decisions affect sales mix and pricing in key markets such as India.

source.name: Trak.in - Indian Business of Tech, Mobile & Startups

sources.name: Trak.in - Indian Business of Tech, Mobile & Startups

na088ad95ea.headline: British Gas, OVO, EDF, EON and Octopus customers face 'soul-destroying' rule change
na088ad95ea.summary: The new energy price cap is expected to be announced by regulator Ofgem next week, affecting customers of British Gas, OVO, EDF, E.ON and Octopus.
na088ad95ea.why: The Ofgem price cap sets the maximum unit rates suppliers can charge UK households, shaping energy suppliers' margins and consumer bills.

n023fedddea.headline: Naira continues appreciation against dollar at black market
n023fedddea.summary: The naira has continued to appreciate against the dollar on Nigeria's parallel foreign exchange market, reaching N1,505 per dollar. The source report is cut off, so the full rate is unconfirmed.
n023fedddea.why: The parallel market rate is a key gauge of Nigerian currency pressure and of the gap between official and informal dollar pricing that affects foreign investors.

n93aa56928e.headline: Santorini Earthquakes: Tourism Holds Strong Amid Emergency Measures
n93aa56928e.summary: Officials have implemented emergency measures on Santorini after seismic activity, yet visitors continue to flock to the Greek island. Tourism is holding up despite the earthquakes.
n93aa56928e.why: Tourism is a major share of Greek economic output, so visitor flows on the islands affect hospitality, transport and local employment.

n5717423cbf.headline: Budget 2025: Was the decision to increase VAT by 2% such a bad idea?
n5717423cbf.summary: The Citizen reports that a 2% VAT increase set for 12 March will hit poorer and middle-class consumers hardest. Economists warn consumers are already under pressure.
n5717423cbf.why: Value-added tax changes alter consumer spending power and government revenue, which affect South African growth, inflation and bond markets.

ncf7fca4071.headline: Supreme Court quashes garnishee order against CBN, says...
ncf7fca4071.summary: Nigeria's Supreme Court set aside a garnishee order issued against the Central Bank of Nigeria and dismissed the proceedings initiated by Inalegwu Frankline. The ruling removes the order against the CBN.
ncf7fca4071.why: The Central Bank of Nigeria manages the naira and monetary policy, so court rulings on its assets affect confidence in the country's financial institutions.

n59f8c758f9.headline: Power generation hits 5,543MW as govt reveals new plans
n59f8c758f9.summary: Nigeria's federal government is considering moving most electricity consumers to Band A, which guarantees a minimum supply of 20 hours. Power generation has reached 5,543MW.
n59f8c758f9.why: Electricity tariff bands set what consumers pay and how reliably utilities are paid, which affects the financial health of Nigeria's power distribution companies.

n084c9baa14.headline: Feds approve another deepwater oil export terminal off Texas coast
n084c9baa14.summary: Federal regulators approved another deepwater oil export terminal off the Texas coast. The project continues an oil export infrastructure buildout that supports U.S. oil production growth.
n084c9baa14.why: Export capacity determines how much US crude can reach global buyers, which shapes benchmark oil prices and the economics of US producers.

n35d198f0b0.headline: Repsol cuts its green hydrogen target by up to 63%.
n35d198f0b0.summary: Repsol cut its 2030 green hydrogen production target by up to 63%, CEO Josu Jon Imaz said. He pointed to the challenges of a high-cost sector that relies heavily on support.
n35d198f0b0.why: Repsol is a Spanish integrated energy company, and its hydrogen plans signal how major oil companies are reprioritising low-carbon investments.

impacts.name: Repsol
impacts.why: Lower hydrogen targets reduce planned capital spending on a costly growth area, which changes the company's investment outlook.

n82690b0f9d.summary: Vale shares have held strong despite a fourth-quarter loss, according to the report, which asks what is driving investor optimism. No further figures were provided in the input.
n82690b0f9d.why: Vale is one of the world's largest iron ore producers, so its results and share price reflect steel demand from China and global mining conditions.

n6c1ae69da7.headline: 11 Lakh CNG Vehicles To Be Sold In 2025: India Will Have 75 Lakh CNG Vehicles
n6c1ae69da7.summary: Indian CNG vehicle sales are expected to reach 1.1 million units in FY25. The total CNG vehicle count is projected to hit 7.5 million, reflecting a 12% CAGR.
n6c1ae69da7.why: CNG vehicles run on compressed natural gas, so their growth affects domestic gas demand, fuel-distribution investment, and automaker sales in India.

n495d5d4daf.headline: Shekel gains continue as Gaza talks progress | The Jerusalem Post
n495d5d4daf.summary: The shekel continues to trade at its strongest levels against the dollar since early 2023, as Gaza talks progress.
n495d5d4daf.why: The shekel is Israel's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect importers, exporters and foreign investors in Israeli assets.

nd06435cbcf.headline: China leaves benchmark lending rates unchanged as expected in Feb
nd06435cbcf.summary: China left benchmark lending rates unchanged at the monthly fixing, as authorities slow monetary stimulus to prioritise financial and currency stability. A weaker yuan and narrower bank margins limit Beijing's room to cut.
nd06435cbcf.why: Loan prime rates are China's benchmark lending rates, and their level influences credit growth, bank profitability and yuan-denominated asset prices.

n4c035c15bd.headline: Rebasing: How Nigeria’s new inflation figures obscure...
n4c035c15bd.summary: The recalibration of Nigeria's inflation index to a headline rate of 24.48% is being hailed by some as progress. Commentary says a closer look reveals issues with the new figures.
n4c035c15bd.why: Inflation figures in Nigeria shape central bank policy, bond yields and the naira outlook for investors in Africa's largest economy.

n9948b65cd8.headline: FG funding MOFI with N150bn at FMBN’s expense –Senate
n9948b65cd8.summary: The Nigerian Senate expressed concern over the federal government's N150 billion investment in a real estate fund, saying it was made at the expense of the Federal Mortgage Bank.
n9948b65cd8.why: Public funding of real estate vehicles and mortgage institutions affects Nigeria's housing finance market and public spending priorities.

n6921edcc84.headline: Senate set for public hearing on Tax Reform Bills
n6921edcc84.summary: The Senate Committee on Finance will hold public hearings on Monday and Tuesday of next week on tax reform bills forwarded to both chambers.
n6921edcc84.why: Tax reform changes government revenue and the tax burden on businesses and investors, which shapes the investment climate in Nigeria.

n19729ed25b.headline: USAID B’Haram controversy: Nigeria may miss $603m fund, Senate summons service chiefs
n19729ed25b.summary: Nigeria's access to a $602.95m USAID grant for 2025 is uncertain after a 90-day suspension, and the Senate has summoned service chiefs over the matter.
n19729ed25b.why: USAID is the US government's foreign aid agency, and its grants fund health, development and security programmes in recipient countries like Nigeria.

n607ddfb0d9.headline: Lundberg's net asset value was SEK 617 per share on February 18, raises dividend (update)
n607ddfb0d9.summary: Lundberg's net asset value was SEK 617 per share on February 18, up from SEK 555 at year-end, and the board proposes an increased dividend.
n607ddfb0d9.why: Lundberg is a Swedish real estate and investment company, and its net asset value and dividend reflect the value of its property portfolio.

n339560bcb5.headline: ‘Ghana is a crime scene; the economy was criminally handled’ – President Mahama
n339560bcb5.summary: President John Mahama accused former president Akufo-Addo of reckless economic mismanagement and vowed to cut government expenditure. The national daily minimum wage rises to GH₵19.97 from March 1, 2025.
n339560bcb5.why: Government spending decisions and wage policy shape inflation, fiscal balances and sovereign credit assessments for investors in Ghana.

nf83891fcb2.headline: Buyers paying stamp duty to double in some areas following April changes
nf83891fcb2.summary: The proportion of first-time buyers in England and Northern Ireland paying stamp duty will double from April. The change follows revisions to the tax.
nf83891fcb2.why: Stamp duty is a tax on property purchases in England and Northern Ireland, and changes to it can affect housing transaction volumes and prices.

n89532d71f2.headline: IRS cuts over 6,000 jobs in the middle of tax season
n89532d71f2.summary: The IRS is cutting more than 6,000 jobs this week as part of the Trump administration's downsizing of the federal workforce. The cuts come during tax-filing season.
n89532d71f2.why: The Internal Revenue Service is the US federal tax agency, and its staffing levels affect tax processing and collection capacity.

n39f5af7094.headline: New Aito M9 with four lidars revealed in EREV and EV variants
n39f5af7094.summary: Aito revealed the new M9 with four lidars in extended-range electric and battery electric variants. The M9 has ranked first in luxury vehicle sales above 500,000 yuan for 10 consecutive months.
n39f5af7094.why: Aito is a Chinese premium electric vehicle brand, and luxury segment sales show competitive positioning in China's large auto market. Lidar sensors are used in advanced driver-assistance systems.

n68a380967b.headline: RBA’s Hauser: Rate cut justified, but inflation fight not a done deal
n68a380967b.summary: RBA Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said the 25 basis point cut to 4.10% was justified. He said an alternative inflation forecast played a key role in the board's decision to ease.
n68a380967b.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, which influences borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and bond yields.

n99765fd984.headline: Maextro S800 released in China as Maybach rival with 6C charging
n99765fd984.summary: Huawei's Maextro S800 was officially released in China as a domestic rival to the Mercedes-Benz Maybach S-Class. The vehicle offers 6C charging capability.
n99765fd984.why: Huawei is a Chinese technology company that has expanded into premium electric vehicles through partnerships with carmakers.

nf920a573c1.headline: Nikko Asset Management and Tikehau Capital found joint private assets venture
nf920a573c1.summary: Nikko Asset Management and Tikehau Capital are creating a private assets venture based in Singapore that will focus on Asian markets.
nf920a573c1.why: Nikko Asset Management is a Japanese asset manager, and Tikehau Capital is a French alternative investment firm, so the venture links two asset managers.

ndaa99ab429.headline: Loke: Logistics sector should make use of tax exemption
ndaa99ab429.summary: Malaysia's Transport Minister said the logistics industry should take advantage of government tax exemptions to adopt Industry 4.0 technology and strengthen the sector.
ndaa99ab429.why: Logistics firms are a key part of trade-linked supply chains, and government incentives shape their technology spending and competitiveness.

na6f3cf4d06.headline: Conservative Merz leads Germany's turbulent election race - World News
na6f3cf4d06.summary: Conservative Friedrich Merz is the strong favourite to become the next German chancellor ahead of Sunday's vote. The campaign has been roiled by the rise of the far-right AfD party.
na6f3cf4d06.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and the chancellor shapes fiscal, energy and industrial policy. Election outcomes affect German bonds, the euro and the outlook for European business.

ncc5f14ca9d.headline: Black farmers among those left in limbo amid federal funding freeze
ncc5f14ca9d.summary: A federal funding halt from the Trump administration has left Black farmers in limbo. The freeze adds to a history of discrimination in federal farm support programmes.
ncc5f14ca9d.why: Federal farm funding programmes affect agricultural incomes and the broader US food supply chain.

n2523eae982.headline: UOB unveils US$2bil payout as profit rises
n2523eae982.summary: United Overseas Bank announced a S$3 billion package over three years to return surplus capital to shareholders. The bank reported a record 2024 profit of S$6 billion.
n2523eae982.why: UOB is a major Singapore-based bank, and its capital return plans affect dividend and buyback expectations for its shareholders.

impacts.name: United Overseas Bank
impacts.why: Capital returns to shareholders can support share value and investor payout expectations.

n870e138e08.summary: Walmart beat earnings and revenue estimates for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025, driven by strong e-commerce growth and operational efficiency.

n750992b52c.why: Alibaba is one of China's largest e-commerce and cloud computing companies, and its results are closely watched as a gauge of China's consumer and tech sectors.

nfdc910522b.headline: KKR wins control of US$4.4 billion Fuji Soft after clash with Bain
nfdc910522b.summary: KKR has won control of Fuji Soft, valued at US$4.4 billion, after a contest with Bain Capital. The software company's human resources and real estate holdings were central to the bidding.
nfdc910522b.why: KKR is a global private equity firm, and take-private deals reshape corporate ownership and capital allocation in the target market.

n8c2fc10144.headline: Lights out for Indonesia civil servants as Prabowo cuts budgets
n8c2fc10144.summary: President Prabowo Subianto ordered sweeping budget cuts across government, affecting civil servants through measures such as switched-off office lights and out-of-service lifts. The cuts are reported by The Business Times.
n8c2fc10144.why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, and government spending cuts shape domestic demand, fiscal deficits and the outlook for its sovereign bonds and rupiah.

n9828a55216.headline: KKR Completes Tender Offer for FUJI SOFT
n9828a55216.summary: KKR completed its tender offer for FUJI SOFT and became the largest shareholder with 58% ownership. The company will now proceed with privatization.
n9828a55216.why: KKR is a global private equity firm, and take-privates of listed Japanese companies are a major part of its investment activity.

n07e386afcb.headline: Gold and yen bask in the limelight
n07e386afcb.summary: Investors are wary after a week of tariff headlines and geopolitical concerns, which have pushed stocks lower. Gold and the yen have attracted demand in this environment.
n07e386afcb.why: Gold and the yen are traditional safe-haven assets that investors often buy during periods of trade tension and geopolitical stress.

n5ad12e14d6.headline: China Finally Addresses Foreign Investment Disaster with 'Action Plan'
n5ad12e14d6.summary: China's Ministry of Commerce unveiled a 20-point action plan on Wednesday to stabilise foreign investment. The measures are aimed at reassuring overseas investors.
n5ad12e14d6.why: Foreign direct investment is important to China's growth, and policy measures toward foreign firms influence investor sentiment across Chinese equities and the yuan.

nbda477acfc.headline: Korean battery-makers brace for CATL’s European expansion
nbda477acfc.summary: CATL, the world's largest battery maker, is eyeing a $5 billion Hong Kong listing to scale up its Hungarian plant, and South Korean EV battery makers are preparing for its expansion.
nbda477acfc.why: CATL is the leading global supplier of EV batteries, so its expansion affects competition for automakers and rival battery producers.

na7b7137076.headline: Lenovo’s profit beats estimates as AI fuels PC recovery hopes
na7b7137076.summary: Lenovo's profit beat analyst estimates. Investors expect PC makers, including HP and Dell Technologies, to benefit in 2025 as consumers buy devices with more AI features.
na7b7137076.why: Lenovo is one of the world's largest PC makers, so its results are a read-through for global PC demand and the sector's recovery.

n158e933dda.headline: Rumor suggests Nvidia’s had difficulties to iron out with chips for RTX 5070 and 5060 GPUs, seemingly leading to delays and possibly low stock levels
n158e933dda.summary: A rumor suggests Nvidia has had difficulties resolving chip issues for its RTX 5070 and 5060 GPUs, which could cause launch delays and low stock levels.
n158e933dda.why: Nvidia is the leading designer of graphics processors and AI chips, so its supply and product timing affect gaming, data center and semiconductor markets.

impacts.why: Reported supply problems and possible shortages could affect Nvidia's GPU sales in the launch period.

n193b311e9b.headline: ADB approves 125 mln USD loan to modernize water supply in Uzbekistan
n193b311e9b.summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a $125 million loan to modernize water management, improve water security and expand access to safe water in Uzbekistan.
n193b311e9b.why: The Asian Development Bank is a multilateral lender that funds infrastructure projects across Asia and the Pacific.

nd2ac496ac4.headline: BOARDWALK REIT REPORTS STRONG RESULTS FOR 2024, INCREASES DISTRIBUTION BY 12.5% AND INTRODUCES GUIDANCE FOR 2025
nd2ac496ac4.summary: Boardwalk Real Estate Investment Trust reported strong results for 2024 and increased its distribution by 12.5%. The company also introduced guidance for 2025.
nd2ac496ac4.why: Boardwalk REIT owns and operates apartment communities in western Canada and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Distribution increases and guidance signal its cash flow outlook to income investors.

nbf999c26db.headline: Bruce County launches survey to assess local impact of U.S. tariffs
nbf999c26db.summary: Bruce County is surveying local businesses on how U.S. tariffs might affect them. The survey was drafted by the Western Ontario Wardens Caucus.
nbf999c26db.why: Tariffs on Canadian exports affect trade-exposed regional businesses in Ontario. Local impact surveys help governments gauge the scale of the economic effect.

nf6c2009883.headline: Niagara restaurants vulnerable as tariffs and rising costs threaten industry
nf6c2009883.summary: The Canadian restaurant industry, particularly in Niagara, is bracing for challenges from new tariffs and rising operational costs. The article warns of pressure on the sector.
nf6c2009883.why: Restaurants operate on thin margins and are sensitive to input costs and consumer spending. Tariffs can raise food and equipment prices that feed into operating costs.

n4e63e329bc.headline: Pan American Silver (PAAS) Q4 2024 Earnings Call Transcript
n4e63e329bc.summary: Pan American Silver held its earnings call for the quarter and year ending December 31, 2024. The transcript covers the company's fourth-quarter results.
n4e63e329bc.why: Pan American Silver is a Vancouver-based silver and gold miner, and its quarterly results reflect production and metal price exposure.

n292faf0926.headline: Azasend: Connecting Digital Assets with Traditional Finance
n292faf0926.summary: Nigeria’s cryptocurrency market is among the fastest-growing globally, with digital assets used for transactions, savings, and investments.
n292faf0926.why: The expansion of digital assets influences financial inclusion, regulation, and investment flows in Nigeria.

na0ae6b4bbb.headline: What will decide your vote at the 2025 federal election? Take our reader survey
na0ae6b4bbb.summary: Voters in Australia indicate economic concerns as key factors influencing their election choices.
na0ae6b4bbb.why: Election outcomes can lead to policy shifts affecting business regulation, taxation, and economic growth.
